segments.caption: GovGrid: AI-Powered Digital Public Infrastructure
segments.narration: Welcome to GovGrid. Autonomous budget reconciliation for municipal digital public infrastructure.

segments.caption: Executive Briefing: Real-time municipal capital oversight
segments.narration: GovGrid reconciles citizen distress signals directly against municipal e-procurement contracts.

segments.caption: Spatial Priority Matrix: Identifying infrastructure anomalies
segments.narration: Active distress clusters are automatically prioritized by severity and geographic impact.

segments.caption: Command Palette: Instant navigation across civic datasets
segments.narration: Administrators search tenders, statutory audits, and citizen records in milliseconds.

segments.caption: Jan-Vani: Grassroots Vernacular Voice Processing
segments.narration: Citizens report infrastructure damage in Telugu, Kannada, and Hindi via WhatsApp voice notes.

segments.caption: Vertex AI Chirp 2: Vernacular Indic language processing
segments.narration: Chirp two transcribes colloquial Indic dialects with ninety-eight percent phonetic accuracy.

segments.caption: Audio Playback: High-fidelity citizen distress verification
segments.narration: Audio evidence is verified with geocoded coordinates before cross-referencing public procurement.

segments.caption: Tender Audits: Cross-referencing GeM public contracts
segments.narration: GovGrid surfaces contractors billing for completed road repairs where citizen grievances persist.

segments.caption: Forensic Discrepancy Dossier: Automated evidence binding
segments.narration: Discrepancy reports compile satellite imagery, citizen testimony, and billing records.

segments.caption: GFR Rule 175: Instant statutory payment freeze
segments.narration: Commissioners freeze milestone tranches with one click under municipal financial statutory rules.

segments.caption: BigQuery GIS: ST_DWithin 500-meter buffer analysis
segments.narration: BigQuery GIS maps citizen complaint clusters directly against active geospatial tender polygons.

segments.caption: Geospatial Reconciliation: Visualizing contractor compliance
segments.narration: Interactive maps expose infrastructure gaps that traditional municipal audits miss entirely.

segments.caption: Civic Knowledge Base: Transparent open governance
segments.narration: Complete documentation of algorithmic audit rules, legal frameworks, and grievance resolution pathways.

segments.caption: Built for Code for Communities Season 2 • Track 1
segments.narration: GovGrid brings accountable transparency to public funds. Live now at govgrid dot web dot app.
